individual-data-points.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter/dot plots with each animal's individual value plotted alongside the mean±SD line.
Panel B is a macroscopic photograph, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C consists of histology/staining micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a dot blot and methylene blue stain image, not a plot of averaged data.
The 5mC/methylene blue ratio bar chart displays individual data points (dots) for each animal overlaid on the bars.
The bottom bar chart quantifying TET1/2/3 over GAPDH shows individual data points overlaid on each bar; the upper blot images do not require this.
